title: Network access
allow: Allow access from other devices on the network
allow_help: Phones, tablets and other computers in the same network can then use vinyl-check in their browser, for example right at the turntable. Each device enters the access code once. When this is off, vinyl-check can only be used on this computer.
remote_hint: You are using vinyl-check from another device. Network access can only be changed on the computer that runs vinyl-check.
qr_hint: Scan the QR code with the phone's camera. It contains the access code, so the phone is signed in right away.
no_qr: No QR code available: the package segno is not installed.
code_hint: Or open the address on the device and enter this code once.
new_code_confirm: Create a new access code? Every device that is signed in has to enter the new code.
firewall_hint: If the firewall of this computer asks whether vinyl-check may accept incoming connections, allow it for private networks.
no_address: No network address found. Is this computer connected to a network?
config_hint_desktop: These values are in {file}; create the file if it does not exist yet. Quit and reopen vinyl-check after changing it.
